A_csv_reachability.verdict: DEAD CODE: load_labeled_records / GTExTissueLoader are defined but never called by any module. data/adr_records.csv never enters training.

B_tissue_source.verdict: SYNTHETIC: training conditions on np.random.dirichlet noise, not GTEx. The real CSV has 128 PCA features; training allocates 1024.

C_label_organ_dependence.verdict: NO ORGAN SIGNAL: _build_target_vector() never receives the organ, so all 10 organs for a drug get an identical target. Independently, in the real CSV 0/1465 molecules have labels that differ across organs. An organ-conditioned model therefore has nothing organ-specific to learn.

D_benchmark_scale.verdict: 5 molecules, each duplicated 8x across 10 organs = 400 rows but only 5 independent label vectors. 5-fold CV therefore evaluates on 1 molecule per fold.
